profile.name: 可编程量子系统控制器
profile.description: 用于量子实验平台中的系统级时序与触发控制设备，可配置触发重复次数和触发间隔，并启动、停止及监测触发序列的执行进度。
profile.description_en: A system-level timing and trigger control instrument for quantum experiments. It configures trigger repetitions and trigger intervals, and can start, stop, and monitor the progress of trigger sequence execution.
